summary: End-to-end verification of Everything Share (backend + Expo web). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases green — device register/get-by-id/get-by-code/patch, file upload (text + PNG), 404 for unknown sender/code, received/sent/all list endpoints (sorted DESC), filename regex search, mime-kind filter, GET/download/favorite/delete of a file, and WebSocket delivery of both file.received and file.sent events after upload. Frontend: onboarding → home code, /send resolves target on 6-digit code entry, /receive renders QR + big code + copy button, /files search + filter chips render, /preview/{id} shows Download/Present/Delete for text files, /smartboard/{id} exposes pointer/pen/highlight/laser/eraser + clear/exit + color swatches + timer, theme chips (system/light/dark) toggle, dark theme persists. One functional bug: Settings device-name input is empty on first mount (state initialised before device loads from AsyncStorage), so Save stays disabled until the user types. Naming note for main agent: filter chip testIDs are singular (filter-favorite / filter-image / filter-video / filter-pdf / filter-doc / filter-audio), differing from the plural labels in the review request — spec should be aligned to the current keys or vice versa. Non-blocking RN Web console warnings: shadow* props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) — these come from library styles, safe to ignore for now.

minor.issue: Response returns 404 only when sender OR code is unknown; behaviour is correct but there is no validation of empty filename or zero-byte files. Not a blocker.
6-digit codes may (rarely) collide across the DB — make_unique_code retries 20× which is fine, but there is no unique index on devices.code.

ui_bugs.issue: Device name TextInput mounts empty because useState(device?.name || '') runs on the first render when device is still null (loaded async from storage). User must retype name before Save is enabled. Fix: sync via useEffect(() => setName(device?.name || ''), [device?.id, device?.name]).

issues: Filter chip testIDs are singular (filter-favorite, filter-image, filter-video, filter-pdf, filter-doc, filter-audio) — review spec lists plural labels (favorites/images/videos/pdfs/docs/audio). Update the review contract or add aliases.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted from RN Web internals — verify no in-app style uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius directly on web; migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Grep the codebase for `pointerEvents=` and move to StyleSheet.

action_items: Fix Settings screen: sync local `name` state when `device` becomes available (useEffect on device.id / device.name).
Reconcile filter chip testIDs vs review spec — either rename keys to plural in files.tsx FILTERS array (favorites/images/videos/pdfs/docs/audio) OR update the review contract to singular.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow, and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to remove deprecation warnings on web.
(Nice-to-have) Add a unique index on devices.code in MongoDB to guarantee uniqueness.
(Nice-to-have) Consider WebRTC hand-off — currently everything is cloud-relay only; noted as deferred in the problem statement.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates devices/files/ws — good. WSManager silently disconnects on send failure — fine for MVP.
backend/server.py delete endpoint removes disk file BUT does not gracefully handle concurrent deletes (rare race). Not critical.

AppContext.tsx stores device via storage.setItem(JSON.stringify(d)) — the storage util already JSON-serialises; that leads to double-encoded JSON in localStorage. The app decodes correctly on load, but consider passing the raw object to storage.setItem to keep the on-disk shape consistent (matches TypeScript signature of StorageItemValue).
settings.tsx line 19: state initialised from possibly-null device; add useEffect sync (see ui_bugs).
files.tsx: horizontal filter chip strip is fine on 390px viewport; consider adding minimum touch target (44px) — chips are ~40px tall which is under Apple HIG.
seed_data_creation: Tests register two TEST_-prefixed devices per run and upload small in-memory text/PNG files; these are left in the DB (cleanup not implemented) but harmless and easy to grep by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Only real bug is the Settings name-input pre-population. Filter chip testID naming (singular vs plural) is a spec/contract question, not a functional break. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for base URL. To upload from the browser, remember AsyncStorage web shim double-encodes JSON — do `JSON.parse(JSON.parse(raw))` when reading es.device.v1 directly from localStorage in Playwright.
rca_of_issue: Settings-name-empty bug — root cause: `const [name, setName] = useState(device?.name || '');` in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx line 19 initialises exactly once. On first mount, AppContext is still loading `device` from storage, so `device` is null and `name` locks to ''. The render then returns null via `if (!device) return null` (line 46), but when the next render happens with device populated, useState is NOT re-run, so `name` stays ''. Repro: cold-load /settings after fresh onboarding → name input is empty. Mitigation: add `useEffect(() => { setName(device?.name || ''); }, [device?.id, device?.name]);`.
